companyDirectionBlock.title: Building Long-Term Industrial Value.
companyDirectionBlock.missionP1: Our mission is to provide customers in the oil & gas, energy, petrochemical, and industrial sectors with highly reliable equipment, certified spare parts, and integrated supply solutions.
companyDirectionBlock.missionP2: We deliver reliable industrial solutions today while ensuring every piece of machinery is tailored to your exact technical and operational requirements for the industries of tomorrow.

scoping.title: Technical Scoping
scoping.description: Analyzing your operational specifications, required tolerances, capacity, and electrical standards before vendor selection.

sourcing.title: Global Sourcing
sourcing.description: Engaging directly with verified OEMs across Korea, Taiwan, Japan, and Europe to match your exact performance requirements.

qa.title: Quality Assurance
qa.description: Overseeing Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), validating strict CE/ISO/API compliance, and executing pre-shipment reviews.

logistics.title: Freight Delivery
logistics.description: Managing heavy industrial crating, comprehensive export documentation, customs clearances, and secure final site delivery.

globalNetworkBlock.title: Seoul Hub // Global Supply Reach
globalNetworkBlock.description: Headquartered in Seoul, Pacific Solutions is the single coordination anchor linking East Asia's precision manufacturing corridors with energy and industrial operations worldwide.
globalNetworkBlock.paragraph1: From Seoul, we manage sourcing, quality control, and logistics across Japan, Taiwan, Vietnam, and Singapore. Our teams work directly with qualified manufacturers, so specifications, inspections, and delivery schedules are handled in one place rather than passed between intermediaries.
globalNetworkBlock.paragraph2: Our European partners in Frankfurt, London, Milan, and Istanbul receive the same supply chain visibility and a single point of contact. Whether it is a one-off urgent order or a long-term supply agreement, every shipment follows a consistent process from factory floor to final destination.
